description_en: An SMS template defines the content that recipients receive, including variables and template body. You can apply for verification code, notification, or promotional SMS templates based on your business needs. Messages can be sent only after the template is approved
description_zh: 短信模板即接收方收到短信的详细内容，包括变量和模板内容。您可以根据业务需要，申请验证码、通知短信或推广短信，模板审核通过后才可以发送短信
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi create-sms-template --template-name '验证码' --template-content '您正在申请手机注册，验证码为：_code_，5分钟内有效！' --template-type 0 --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSmsTemplate

parameters.help_en: The template name. The name can be up to 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称，长度不超过30个字符
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.example: 您正在申请手机注册，验证码为：${code}，5分钟内有效！
parameters.help_en:
The template content. The content can be up to 500 characters in length.

The template content and variable content must comply with the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/463161.html. Otherwise, the template will fail the review. You can also view common template examples on the Apply for template (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template/add) page. Using example templates can improve the review efficiency and approval rate. For variable specifications, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2806243.html
parameters.help_zh:
模板内容，长度不超过500个字符。

模板内容和变量内容必须符合https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/463161.html，否则模板会审核失败。您也可以在申请模板 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template/add)页面，查看常用模板示例。使用示例模板可提高审核效率和成功率。变量规范请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2806243.html
parameters.name: template_content

parameters.help_en: Describe your business scenario for using SMS or provide an online link to the business scenario, and provide a complete SMS example (with variable content filled in). Complete information helps improve the template approval rate. Failure to fill in the information as required or leaving it blank may affect your template approval
parameters.help_zh: 请描述您使用短信的业务场景或提供业务场景的线上链接，并提供短信完整示例（填入变量内容），信息完整有助于提高模板审核通过率。如未按规范进行填写或不填写，可能会影响您模板审核的通过
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The SMS type. Valid values:

0: verification code.
1: SMS notification.
2: promotional SMS.
3: international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan message.

Only enterprise-authenticated users can apply for promotional SMS and international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan messages. For details about the differences between individual and enterprise user privileges, see Before you begin (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sms/user-guide/usage-notes)
parameters.help_zh:
短信类型。取值：

0：验证码。
1：短信通知。
2：推广短信。
3：国际/港澳台消息。

仅支持企业认证用户申请推广短信和国际/港澳台消息。个人用户与企业用户权益区别详情请参见使用须知 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/sms/user-guide/usage-notes?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.67447f576NJnE8)
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en:
The signature name to associate with the template. The associated SMS signature must be an approved signature.

<notice>

When the TemplateType parameter is set to 0, 1, or 2, this parameter is required.

Associating a signature can improve review efficiency. The signature associated here is unrelated to the signature selected when sending SMS messages.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
模板需要关联的签名名称。关联的短信签名必须为审核通过的签名。

<notice>

当TemplateType参数为0、1、2时，此参数必填。

关联签名可以提升审核效率，此处关联的签名和短信发送时选择的签名无关。</notice>
parameters.name: related_sign_name

parameters.help_en:
The template variable rules. For how to fill in variable rules, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2806243.html.

This field is required if the SMS template contains variables
parameters.help_zh:
模板变量规则。变量规则的填写，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2806243.html。

短信模板里带变量，则此字段必填
parameters.name: template_rule

parameters.help_en: Additional materials. You can upload business proof files or business screenshots to help reviewers understand your business details. If you are applying for a promotional SMS template (TemplateType is 2), upload user authorization proof materials. For specifications, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312341.html
parameters.help_zh: 更多资料，您可以补充上传业务证明文件或业务截图，有助于审核人员了解您的业务详情。如果您申请的短信模板为推广短信（即TemplateType为2），请上传用户授权证明材料，具体说明请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/312341.html
parameters.name: more_data

parameters.help_en:
The business scenario.
If the scenarios of the SMS signature associated with the template is "Online APP", `ApplySceneContent` must be an App link starting with `http://` or `https://`.
If the scenarios of the SMS signature associated with the template is "Registered trademark name" or "Enterprise or public institution name", `ApplySceneContent` is required
parameters.help_zh:
业务场景。
模板关联的短信签名使用场景如果为“已上线APP”，`ApplySceneContent`必须为以`http://`开头或`https://`开头的App链接。
模板关联的短信签名使用场景如果为“已注册商标名”、“企事业单位名称”，`ApplySceneContent`必填
parameters.name: apply_scene_content

parameters.help_en:
The international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan template type. When the TemplateType parameter is set to 3, this parameter must be specified for international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan templates. Valid values:
0: SMS notification.
1: promotional SMS.
2: verification code
parameters.help_zh:
国际/港澳台模板类型。当TemplateType参数为3时，国际/港澳台模板需要设置此参数，取值：
0：短信通知。
1：推广短信。
2：验证码
parameters.name: intl_type

parameters.example: [{"trafficDrivingType":"DOMAIN","trafficDrivingContent":"aliyun.com","companyName":"阿里云计算有限公司","organizationCode":"91330****73959654P","icpNo":"浙B2-20****01-4","icpPicOssKey":"db7784d8-cb0c-498f-****-295f1ad6d665_mf29l7nf.png", "companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason":"这是一段说明文字"},{"trafficDrivingType":"1_PHONE","trafficDrivingContent":"1**86","variableName":"my1Phone","companyName":"阿里云计算有限公司","organizationCode":"91330****73959654P","companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason":"这是一段说明文字"}]
parameters.help_en:
<warning>
To manage SMS content security, SMS content that contains traffic-driving information such as phone numbers and links may be intercepted by carriers, resulting in delivery failures. Avoid including such information in SMS templates to reduce the risk of delivery failures.></warning>

The JSON string of the traffic-driving information list.
<notice>JSON format. Convert to a string before passing in.></notice>

Field description:

{
    "trafficDrivingType":"Traffic-driving type",
    "trafficDrivingContent":"Traffic-driving content",
    "variableName":"Variable name",
    "companyName":"Enterprise or public institution name",
    "organizationCode":"Unified social credit code",
    "icpNo":"ICP filing/license number",
    "icpPicOssKey":"ICP filing screenshot OssKey",
    "companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason":"Reason why the enterprise name differs from the signature qualification"
}

Precautions:

If it is not a variable, do not pass in variableName.

If the enterprise or public institution name differs from the enterprise name in the signature qualification, pass in companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason.

If trafficDrivingType=DOMAIN, pass in all parameters.

If trafficDrivingType is set to other values, pass in trafficDrivingType, trafficDrivingContent, variableName (as needed), companyName, organizationCode, and companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason (as needed).

Enumeration values for trafficDrivingType:
<warning>Due to regulatory requirements, mobile phone numbers are not supported.></warning>
DOMAIN: domain name link.
FIXED_PHONE: landline phone number.
400_PHONE: phone number starting with 400.
800_PHONE: phone number starting with 800.
95_PHONE: phone number starting with 95.
96_PHONE: phone number starting with 96.
1_PHONE: phone number starting with 1, 3 to 8 digits.
OTHER_PHONE: other phone numbers
parameters.help_zh:
<warning>
为管控短信内容安全，短信内容中包含“号码、链接”等引流信息，存在被运营商拦截导致发送失败的风险。建议尽可能在短信模板中避免包含相关信息，以降低短信发送失败风险。></warning>

引流信息列表JSON字符串。
<notice>JSON格式，传入前请转为字符串。></notice>

字段说明：

{
    "trafficDrivingType":"引流类型",
    "trafficDrivingContent":"引流内容",
    "variableName":"变量名称",
    "companyName":企事业单位名称,
    "organizationCode":统一社会信用代码,
    "icpNo":ICP备案/许可证号,
    "icpPicOssKey":ICP备案截图OssKey,
    "companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason":企事业单位名称与签名资质不同原因
}

注意事项：

如果非变量则variableName不传。

企事业单位名称与签名关联资质的企事业单位名称不同，则传入companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason。

如果trfficDrivingType=DOMAIN，则传入所有参数。

如果trafficDrivingType为其他，则传入trafficDrivingType、trafficDrivingContent、variableName（按需）、companyName、organizationCode、companyDifferentFromSignQuaReason（按需）

trafficDrivingType引流类型枚举值：
<warning>因监管要求，不支持手机号码。></warning>
DOMAIN：域名类型链接。
FIXED_PHONE：固定电话。
400_PHONE：400开头电话。
800_PHONE：800开头电话。
95_PHONE：95开头电话。
96_PHONE：96开头电话。
1_PHONE：1开头，3~8位电话。
OTHER_PHONE：其他号码
parameters.name: traffic_driving

For other error codes, see the Error codes section of this topic or [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）

其他错误码，请参见本章节的错误码列表或产品[API错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）

The ticket ID.

Reviewers use this parameter when querying reviews. Provide this ticket ID when you need to expedite the review
OrderId.description_zh:
工单号。

审核人员查询审核时会用到此参数。您需要审核加急时需要提供此工单号

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID。是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TemplateCode.description_en:
The SMS template code.

After submitting a template application, you can use the SMS template code to call the [GetSmsTemplate]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807433.html） operation to query the template review details. You can also [configure receipt messages]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101508.html） and obtain the template review status through [TemplateSmsReport]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120999.html）
TemplateCode.description_zh:
短信模板Code。

提交模板申请后，您可以使用短信模板Code，通过[GetSmsTemplate]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807433.html）接口查询模板审核详情。也可以[配置回执消息]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101508.html），通过[TemplateSmsReport]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120999.html）获取模板的审核状态消息
